note: Interactive setup session with the owner. Not a scheduled run. Summarized after the fact.

decisions.what: Project 1 is Rewind, a time-travel debugger
decisions.why: Owner asked for 'wow' projects; Rewind plays to his frontend strength and is visual

decisions.what: Cursor writes all code, Claude plans, reviews and conducts
Tasks live in GitHub issues with milestones per week
decisions.why: Planning becomes public activity; Cursor can take an issue by @cursor comment

decisions.what: One task per day, split into 4-6 parts, a fresh agent per part
decisions.why: Owner asked for small parts with their own prompts, checks and commits instead of one big session

decisions.what: Test-first inside each part: test commit then implementation commit
decisions.why: Stops agents from fitting tests to their code; reviewer checks tests are not weakened

decisions.what: Auto-merge in the evening after a day of review, owner can write 'hold'
decisions.why: Owner wants the chain to keep going on days he is away

decisions.what: Rewrite commit authorship to the owner before merge, keep Cursor as co-author
decisions.why: Cursor commits as cursoragent, which does not count on the owner's profile

decisions.what: Black-box QA in the same repo via GitHub Actions + Cursor CLI + Playwright MCP, no code checked out
decisions.why: Owner did not want a separate repo; sparse checkout keeps code out of reach

decisions.what: Bug status labels: new, fixing, fixed, verified, not-a-bug
decisions.why: Owner asked for bug statuses beyond open/closed

decisions.what: Process moved into .agentflow/ with a generic playbook and a project config
decisions.why: Owner wants one reusable process template for any new repo

decisions.what: Log every action to agentflow-log and write weekly retros
decisions.why: Owner wants the full record to adapt the template after a week

problems: Initial commits used an email tied to another GitHub account (qamalyannn). Fixed by using the SergeiKamalian noreply email everywhere.
Status label on issue #1 was not updated when the agent finished. Fixed with status-labels.yml.
Vercel previews required login, so QA could not open them. Owner turned off Vercel Authentication.
Main CI failed after adding .agentflow scripts because Biome also lints them. Fixed by formatting with Biome.
GraphQL is not available to the conductor; ready-for-review needs the ccr route. Noted in the playbook.
The session cannot delete branches; demo branch qa-demo/planted-bug is left for the owner to delete.
Playwright browser download is blocked in the conductor sandbox; a preinstalled Chromium works.
processNotes: Day 01 ran as a pilot: one agent, no parts, no test-first. Parts start on Day 02.
QA demo on PR #10 proved the full bug loop: found (#11) -> fixing -> fixed -> verified and closed, about 35 minutes end to end.
Cursor finished Day 01 in about 30 minutes. A 'day' is a planning unit, not agent time.
Template still has Rewind-specific bits (pnpm commands in prompts, recorder rules). To extract after week 1.
